title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
plot_overview: A breakdancer’s unexpected path to the 2024 Paris Olympics takes a sudden turn when her performance goes viral. As memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories spread, the documentary explores the attention surrounding her Olympic moment and how she came to compete.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re curious about viral moments, Olympic competition, and the stories behind public scrutiny; Not for you if you want a lighthearted sports documentary or a neatly resolved account.
review_summary: Pros: timely subject; explores online reaction; personal perspectives | Cons: uneven portrayal; leaves questions open; divisive subject
